# Ubiquiti UniFi Switch Flex 2.5G 8 PoE — Compact 2.5GbE Edge Switch

**Category:** Networking gear (Switch)

**MSRP:** $199.00

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Port Layout | 8x 2.5GbE RJ45 (all PoE++), 1x 10GbE RJ45/SFP+ combo uplink (PoE+++ capable) |
| Switching Capacity | 60 Gbps |
| Non-Blocking Throughput | 30 Gbps |
| Forwarding Rate | 45 Mpps |
| Supported VLANs | 256 |
| MAC Address Table Size | 4,000 |
| Max. PoE Output | Up to PoE++ (64W max per port) |
| Total PoE Availability | 76W (PoE+++ input) / 46W (PoE++ input) / 16W (PoE+ input) / 196W (with optional 210W AC adapter) |
| Max. PoE Wattage per Port | PoE: 15.4W, PoE+: 32W, PoE++: 64W |
| Power Method | (1) AC/DC adapter (sold separately), (1) PoE+++ input |
| Power Input | DC input or PoE, 50–57V DC/PoE supported voltage range |
| Max. Power Consumption | 14W excl. PoE (PoE-powered) / 17W excl. PoE (AC-powered) / 210W incl. PoE output |
| Layer 2 Features | STP/RSTP, egress rate limit, flow control, storm control, multicast/broadcast rate limiting, port isolation, port mirroring, jumbo frames, loop protection |
| Form Factor | Compact desktop, wall, DIN rail, or magnetic mount |
| Dimensions | 212.9 x 99.4 x 33.5 mm (8.4 x 3.9 x 1.3") |
| Weight | 567g (20 oz) |
| Enclosure | Polycarbonate |
| Operating Temp | -20 to 45°C (-4 to 113°F), 10–90% noncondensing humidity |
| Management | Ethernet, via UniFi Network app (version 9.0.114 or later required) |
| Certifications | CE, FCC, IC, NDAA compliant |

## Notable Features

- Flexible power input: draws power via PoE+++ uplink (76W budget) or an optional AC adapter for the full 196W PoE budget across all 8 ports
- 10GbE RJ45/SFP+ combo uplink allows either copper or fiber connection back to the core switch/gateway
- Multiple mounting options (desktop, wall, DIN rail, magnetic) make it well suited as a remote "leaf" switch for device clusters far from the main rack
- Fanless, compact design ideal for closets, cabinets, or wall-mounted deployments powering APs, cameras, and other PoE devices
- Requires a UniFi console (e.g. Cloud Gateway) running UniFi Network 9.0.114+ for full management
